title: Very heavy and super soft
text: Very heavy and super soft. This mattress is super heavy. For sure need two people to carry this. It is made of very nice foam topper and the base..as advertised it is 12 inch height, but length and width are little higher than standard full size mattress. We realized that after putting this on out full size platform bed.  Mattress is too soft for me, other than that everything else seems fine to me.
